description: Each outcome's YES price over time on a competition's side market (GET /api/competitions/<slug>/market/history), oldest first, NONE and the entries (FIELD left out): series [{outcome_id, points: [{t, p}]}], t in Unix seconds (UTC), p the YES price in ppm (1,000,000 is 1 USDC a share; NO's is the rest), a long range cut to at most a few hundred points per outcome (each bucket's last price). range: 1h, 6h, 1d or all (the default: from the market's first price); since: only the points after that instant (ISO 8601 UTC), to add what moved since your last read.

since.description: Only the points after this instant (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-11-20T12:00:00Z)

slug.description: The competition slug, e.g. chess-engine-01 (list_competitions lists them)

name: get_market_history
title: Get a side market's price history
